title: What If Kolo Mee Was Banned?
notes: Written to be SPOKEN in Malaysian English. Narrator kept near 140-150 wpm with pauses before punchlines. Real recordings in assets/voiceover/recorded/e02/<id>.m4a replace TTS automatically. The ban is issued by a made-up 'Noodle Board' and covers every kolo mee (pork or halal chicken) - no religious angle.

scenes.name: The Hook
scenes.visuals: Morning shophouse street in Kuching: queue at Auntie's stall, steaming bowls, birds. A Noodle Board officer with a megaphone: 'kolo mee is BANNED!' Red stamp, the whole street gasps.

scenes.name: Real Facts
scenes.visuals: REAL FACTS badge. Hero bowl of kolo mee with call-outs (springy noodles, tossed dry, char siu — or chicken for halal). Then a laksa bowl with a quote card: 'Breakfast of the gods' — Anthony Bourdain, 2015.

scenes.name: Day One (fiction)
scenes.visuals: ALTERNATE HISTORY — FICTION banner. 'DAY 1' card. Stalls under tarps: 'CLOSED · NOODLE BOARD ORDER (fictional)'. A sad uncle eats spaghetti topped with char siu. 'IT'S NOT THE SAME.'

scenes.name: Underground
scenes.visuals: 'DAY 3'. Night back alley, secret knock. A peephole slides open: Auntie in sunglasses, 'Psst… special laksa?'. Inside: a hidden wok kitchen, a menu board 'SPECIAL LAKSA (very dry)'.

scenes.name: The Raid
scenes.visuals: Torch beams. The officer inspects a 'laksa' with no soup. Sniff. Sweating Auntie: 'New recipe lah!'. Long stare… the officer pulls out a takeaway bag: 'Bungkus one for me.'

scenes.name: Royal Cameo
scenes.visuals: Rajah Edmund from Episode 1, in sunglasses and a cap with his crown poking out, sneaks to the secret stall: extra char siu. Label: 'ROYAL CAMEO (from Episode 1)'.

scenes.name: Reality Check
scenes.visuals: A queue snakes around the block to a tiny secret door. The BAN sign sags, then falls over.

scenes.name: Final Punchline
scenes.visuals: 'DAY 7 · BAN LIFTED' street party with confetti… and everyone is holding laksa. Auntie: 'Aiyo! After all that?!'. End card KOLO MEE 🍜 or LAKSA 🍲? COMMENT BELOW. Loops to the morning street.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kuching. Seven a.m. Everyone's having kolo mee.
lines.tts: Kuching. Seven A.M. Everyone's having [kolo mee](/kˈoʊloʊ mˈiː/).
lines.direction: Warm, relaxed, like describing a normal morning.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Attention! Starting today... kolo mee is BANNED!
lines.tts: Attention! Starting today... [kolo mee](/kˈoʊloʊ mˈiː/) is banned!
lines.direction: Megaphone announcement, very official, slow on 'BANNED'.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Okay. Real facts first.
lines.tts: Okay. Real facts first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kolo mee: Kuching's springy, dry-tossed noodles. Char siu on top... or chicken, for the halal version.
lines.tts: [Kolo mee](/kˈoʊloʊ mˈiː/). Kuching's springy, dry-tossed noodles. Char siu on top... or chicken, for the halal version.
lines.direction: Like a food show host, proud of local food.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And Sarawak laksa? Anthony Bourdain called it 'breakfast of the gods'.
lines.tts: And [Sarawak](/səɹˈɑːwak/) [laksa](/lˈʌksə/)? Anthony Bourdain called it... breakfast of the gods.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now... the made-up part.
lines.tts: Now... the made-up part.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day one. Every stall... closed.
lines.tts: Day one. Every stall... closed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: People try spaghetti. With char siu.
lines.tts: People try spaghetti. With char siu.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's... not the same.
lines.tts: It's... not the same.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day three. Kolo mee goes... underground.
lines.tts: Day three. [Kolo mee](/kˈoʊloʊ mˈiː/) goes... underground.

lines.speaker: auntie
lines.text: Psst! You want... 'special laksa'?
lines.tts: Psst! You want... special [laksa](/lˈʌksə/)?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 'Special laksa.' Very special. Very... dry.
lines.tts: Special [laksa](/lˈʌksə/). Very special. Very... dry.

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: Auntie. Why is your laksa... so dry?
lines.tts: Auntie. Why is your [laksa](/lˈʌksə/)... so dry?

lines.speaker: auntie
lines.text: New recipe lah!
lines.tts: New recipe lah!

lines.speaker: officer
lines.text: ...Okay. Bungkus one for me.
lines.tts: Okay. [Bungkus](/bˈʊŋkʊs/) one for me.
lines.direction: After a long pause, quietly giving up. 'Bungkus' = takeaway.

lines.speaker: rajah
lines.text: One special laksa, extra char siu. Please... don't tell anyone.
lines.tts: One special [laksa](/lˈʌksə/), extra char siu. Please... don't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Even a Rajah from another timeline can't resist.
lines.tts: Even a Rajah from another timeline... can't resist.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So... would a ban really work?
lines.tts: So... would a ban really work?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ban something people love... and they'll find another way.
lines.tts: Ban something people love... and they'll find another way.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Day seven. The ban is lifted!
lines.tts: Day seven. The ban is lifted!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And everyone celebrates... with laksa.
lines.tts: And everyone celebrates... with [laksa](/lˈʌksə/).

lines.speaker: auntie
lines.text: Aiyo! After all that?!
lines.tts: [Aiyo](/aɪjˈoʊ/)! After all that?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kolo mee or laksa? Comment below!
lines.tts: [Kolo mee](/kˈoʊloʊ mˈiː/)... or [laksa](/lˈʌksə/)? Comment below!
